title: Group Policy Preferences Stored Credentials (MS14-025)

references.name: MITRE ATT&CK - T1552.006 Group Policy Preferences

description: Group Policy Preferences used to set local account passwords store them in XML files on SYSVOL, encrypted with a publicly known static AES key (the cPassword attribute). Because any authenticated domain user can read SYSVOL, these credentials can be retrieved and decrypted, frequently yielding local administrator access across many hosts.
businessImpact: Critical --- recovered local administrator credentials often work across numerous systems, enabling widespread lateral movement.
remediation:
- Remove cPassword data from existing GPOs and SYSVOL.
- Apply MS14-025 and stop using GPP to set passwords.
- Use LAPS to manage and rotate unique local administrator passwords.
- Audit SYSVOL for stored credentials.
